segments.text:
HOw may we attain to an Evenness and
Steddiness of heart under the comfortable
Aspects of Providence upon us?

Under Providences of this kind, the great
danger is, lest the heart be lifted up with pride
and vanity, and fall into a drowsie and remiss
temper. To prevent this, we had need urge
humbling and awakening Considerations upon our
own hearts; such are these that follow.
